on Thursday introduced visual search ads, a new performance advertising solution designed to help brands reach consumers through visual search and high-intent discovery moments on the platform.

Announced at Pinterest Presents, the company’s annual global advertiser summit, Visual Search Ads place advertisers prominently within Pinterest search results and pin close-ups, connecting brands with users as they visually search, compare options, and move closer to a decision.

Visual Search Ads support lower-funnel objectives and are compatible with Pinterest Performance+, Pinterest’s AI-powered performance advertising suite, the company said. The offering will be available in beta for eligible advertisers in all Pinterest ad markets in the coming weeks.

title: Pinterest introduces visual search ads to boost performance marketing
